MIDI

  • Notes in from USB and the TRS jack; the keys send on the GLOBAL MIDI CH (OMNI: out on 1).
  • Program change in selects 1-64; PRESETS sends one.
  • Pitch bend by the program's BEND + / BEND -. CC 1 mod wheel brings LFO 2 in.
  • Every knob with a CC sends it when turned, so a DAW records the panel; incoming CCs edit the sound.
  • Clock (24 a beat) sets the arp's tempo while it runs; START restarts the arp on step 1.

SAVE page

SAVEtap

SAVE
TOG1 .. 64
the slot to save into
CURSORG1 .. 16
the name's character to edit
CHARG
that character
A-Z a-z 0-9 ...
MODEG
what SAVE does: p.2
WRITE · SWAP · FACTORY
  • WRITE: the sound as edited into slot TO (a copy, if TO is another slot). The name: CURSOR and CHAR.
  • SWAP: the program playing and slot TO trade places (reorder the bank).
  • FACTORY: slot TO back to the factory sound.
  • A * on the home screen: the sound is edited and not saved. Saving to flash happens once nothing sounds.

Kept where

  • In the program (64 slots): everything on LFO, EDIT, ENV, SEL, TONE, MULTI-FX, DELAY, PLAY MODE, and PERFORM (except PANEL): a program is a performance, two patches (UPPER, LOWER) and how they play.
  • Layered (DUAL / SPLIT): the voice pages edit the PANEL part (header U / L / L+U); TONE, MULTI-FX and DELAY are one chain, UPPER's.
  • On the FM-1 (G): REVERB, ARP, MIDI CH, TEMPO, the octave, the program last played. VOICES starts at 8 at power-on.
